sql_templates.description: Compile FII/DII flow, regime history, market breadth, and index confirmation for the last 20 sessions.
sql_templates.sql:
WITH latest_flows AS (
    SELECT trade_date, fii_net_today, dii_net_today, fii_trend, dii_trend, flow_signal
    FROM signals.fii_dii_flows
    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
), latest_regime AS (
    SELECT trade_date, regime, confidence, days_in_regime
    FROM signals.regime_history
    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
), latest_breadth AS (
    SELECT trade_date, advances, declines, net_ad, ad_signal, trin, market_sentiment
    FROM breadth.market_daily
    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days'
), latest_index AS (
    SELECT trade_date, index_symbol, close, change_pct, trend_signal
    FROM market.index_eod
    WHERE trade_date > CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '20 days' AND index_symbol = 'Nifty 50'
)
SELECT 
    f.trade_date,
    f.fii_net_today, f.dii_net_today, f.fii_trend, f.dii_trend, f.flow_signal,
    r.regime, r.confidence, r.days_in_regime,
    b.advances, b.declines, b.net_ad, b.ad_signal, b.trin, b.market_sentiment,
    i.close, i.change_pct, i.trend_signal
FROM latest_flows f
JOIN latest_regime r ON f.trade_date = r.trade_date
JOIN latest_breadth b ON f.trade_date = b.trade_date
JOIN latest_index i ON f.trade_date = i.trade_date

synthesis_guidance: ['Focus on tracing changes in regime, flow, and market breadth to signal risk-on or risk-off contexts.', 'Leverage debug trace methodology to highlight step-by-step synthesis and interpretation of evidence.']
